factual_claims.claim: Gross profit fell to 13,535 thousand euros from 16,770 thousand euros, resulting in a gross margin of 6.5% compared with 7.5% in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: Gross profit 2025 €13,535k (2024: €16,770k). Gross margin 6.5% (2024: 7.5%).

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit declined to 5,651 thousand euros from 8,061 thousand euros, pushing the operating margin down to 2.7% from 3.6%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: Operating profit 2025 €5,651k (2024: €8,061k). Operating margin 2.7% (2024: 3.6%).

factual_claims.claim: Administrative expenses decreased by about 14% to 6,814 thousand euros, largely due to lower staff costs associated with reduced liabilities for performance-based pay following weaker financial performance.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 11: Administrative expenses 2025 €6,814k (2024: €7,878k) - a ~14% decrease. Employees section attributes this to 'lower staff costs... recognition of a smaller liability for performance-based pay'.

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA dropped to 8,250 thousand euros with an EBITDA margin of 4.0%, compared to 11,025 thousand euros and 4.9% in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: EBITDA 2025 €8,250k (margin 4.0%), 2024 €11,025k (margin 4.9%).

factual_claims.claim: Net finance costs increased significantly to 2,965 thousand euros from 2,333 thousand euros in 2024, heavily impacted by currency fluctuations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income: Net finance costs 2025 €(2,965k), 2024 €(2,333k). Note 13 attributes increase to currency fluctuations.

factual_claims.claim: Specifically, the weakening of the Ukrainian hryvnia against the euro by approximately 12% resulted in a foreign exchange loss of 750 thousand euros on the translation of euro-denominated loans provided to Ukrainian subsidiaries.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13: 'In 2025, the hryvnia weakened against the euro by around 12%. [...] translation [...] gave rise to a foreign exchange loss of €750 thousand'.

factual_claims.claim: Consequently, net profit for the twelve-month period dropped by 51% to 2,545 thousand euros compared with 5,165 thousand euros in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: Net profit 2025 €2,545k (2024: €5,165k). Decrease is (50.8%) ~ 51%.

factual_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to owners of the parent fell to 1,439 thousand euros from 3,827 thousand euros, bringing basic and diluted earnings per share down to 0.05 euros from 0.12 euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income: Profit attributable to owners 2025 €1,439k (2024: €3,827k). Note 7: Basic/diluted EPS 2025 €0.05 (2024: €0.12).

factual_claims.claim: Despite the drop in annual revenue and earnings, the group achieved substantial growth in its order book, which expanded by 30% to 273,060 thousand euros as of 31 December 2025, compared with 209,489 thousand euros at the end of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section: Order book 2025 €273,060k (2024: €209,489k) - a ~30% increase.

factual_claims.claim: This growth was driven primarily by a nearly threefold increase in the Infrastructure segment order book, boosted by major contracts such as the Rail Baltica main line railway infrastructure project and road construction contracts with the Estonian Transport Administration.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section: 'order book of the Infrastructure segment has increased nearly threefold [...] Rail Baltica contract and a contract [...] with the Estonian Transport Administration'.

factual_claims.claim: New contracts secured during the year totaled 234,994 thousand euros, compared with 181,437 thousand euros in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section: New contracts 2025 €234,994k (2024: €181,437k).

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities showed a slight improvement, producing a net cash inflow of 1,204 thousand euros compared with 1,075 thousand euros in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of cash flows: Net cash from operating activities 2025 €1,204k (2024: €1,075k).

factual_claims.claim: Investing activities resulted in a net cash outflow of 2,767 thousand euros, which included 2,898 thousand euros placed in long-term deposits to secure guarantee limits.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of cash flows: Net cash used in investing activities 2025 €(2,767k). Includes 'cash placed in long-term deposits of €2,898k'.

factual_claims.claim: Financing activities resulted in a net cash outflow of 1,194 thousand euros, reflecting loan repayments and lease payments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of cash flows: Net cash used in financing activities 2025 €(1,194k). Breakdown includes loan repayments and lease payments.

factual_claims.claim: The group closed the period with 5,266 thousand euros in cash and cash equivalents, down from 8,195 thousand euros at the end of 2024, while maintaining a current ratio of 0.93.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position: Cash and cash equivalents 2025 €5,266k (2024: €8,195k). Liquidity risk section: Current ratio 0.93 (2024: 0.94).

factual_claims.claim: Backed by the expanded order book, management expects business volumes to increase in 2026 while maintaining strict cost control and risk management in a highly competitive market environment.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section: 'Based on the size of the group’s order book [...] management team expects business volumes to increase in 2026. [...] focus on managing fixed costs [...] in a highly competitive environment.'
